description: A report for one Press Room order (each item's live links, status history, dates, price and spend) or for one brand over a date range (spend, placements ordered and published, audit scores over time, Wikipedia notability checks and website analyses). Use this when the person wants results or spend in one place. Do not use for the status of an order in progress. Side effects: none; read only.

brand_id.description: Or one brand over a date range. Example: "8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f"

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, with brand_id (default: 90 days ago). Example: "2026-07-01"

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, with brand_id (default: today). Example: "2026-09-30"

name: get_report
title: Get a report
